goal: Validate the Student 4 activities frontend, backend readiness, and database-backed category catalogue
_note: All checks are read-only. Health may be degraded because the CI slice intentionally omits optional shared-location, itinerary, and AI services; readiness depends only on the owned database.
rules: Category codes are a fixed catalogue; an activity carries one or more of them and a code is shared by many activities.
Location names are resolved through the shared location service, which is deliberately absent from this CI slice, so health may be degraded while readiness is fine.
All checks here are read-only; do not recommend create, update or delete operations.

steps.label: GET /activity/{first result} (must carry the filtered category)

invariants.label: the OUTDOOR filter matched at least one activity
